data.name: Sharveeshee
data.gender_notes: Sharveeshee is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharveeshee is derived from the Sanskrit language and is the name of the goddess of happiness and wealth. She is believed to bring prosperity, good fortune, and joy to those who invoke her name. The name Sharveeshee carries the meaning “Goddess of Happiness and Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharveeshee usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of happiness and wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharveeshee is a manifestation of the goddess Lakshmi, who is the embodiment of wealth, beauty, and happiness. She is often depicted with gold coins, lotus flowers, and elephants, symbolizing her abundant blessings.
data.etymology: Sharveeshee belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Happiness and Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharveeshee total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
